examples.title: Typing status
examples.description: The original three-dot loader remains available. Override the accessible label to name the work.

examples.title: Dot sizes
examples.description: size accepts a pixel number or a CSS length. These are examples of the existing size prop, rather than named variants.

examples.title: Dot spacing
examples.description: spacing accepts a pixel number or a CSS length independently of the dot size.

examples.title: Semantic colors
examples.description: Use a CSS theme variable for the existing color prop.

examples.title: Conversation reply
examples.description: The dots disappear when a local reply is added. The parent keeps the status message and reply state.
